title: Proof only: a view-source: tab stays out of the agent's tab list
docs: The user attaches a web page (A). Two more tabs are open and not attached: another web page (B) and view-source: of A. The model lists tabs. The tool result's unattached_tabs counts the other tabs TabTools::ListTabs lets through: B alone when view-source: is out of reach, 2 when it is in.
